x: The Middlesex County authorities had decided to hold their championship once again from the Northolt Aerodrome; and the senior event was preceded by a junior race, for those under 21 years of age, over five miles. Our only runner in this race was F.
Jackman proved the winner, with that fine old-stager, Charlie Cook, second; and another one-time stalwart in Dicky Best, third. The 440 Yards was won in fine style by F.
Standard medals for the Championship events were won by the following :— 440 Yards.—F.
